A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the chick embryo erythropoesis is a complex system, in which the erythropoietins play an important role, and which can be studied by means of in vitro techniques.
erythrocytic differentiation from stem cells in the chick embryo requires 2-3 days and about 20 divisions.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the chick embryo erythropoesis is not a single process but rather the sum of several processes.
